WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (yesterday)): Adam added Austin Ekeler (RB, FA) (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 23 (2 days ago)): Wingard added AJ Dillon (RB, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (3 days ago)): Fronge added Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS) (dropped Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (3 days ago)): Drew added Roman Wilson (WR, PIT) for $9 FAAB (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (3 days ago)): Drew added Zach Ertz (TE, PHI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).

WEEK 2 RESULTS: Mitchum def. Corbishley, 160.0-151.7; Brent def. Adam, 98.9-71.1; Ryan def. Drew, 136.7-92.7 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Jake, 146.6-97.9 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Kevin, 205.6-133.6 (BLOWOUT); Shaq def. Wingard, 87.3-70.6

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: LIVE UPDATE: Fronge trailing Wingard 0.0-19.0 to open Week 3. ForgeHammer's Havana headquarters has not yet responded to requests for comment on why the team with zero pick liquidity is currently losing to a 0-4 squad.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Jake is up 34.8-1.5 on Mitchum right now. One week after Mitchum knocked off the two seed with 160 points. The fantasy calendar has no memory and no mercy.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Brent opened 21.0-0.0 on Charles before a single Crownline player has scored. That is either the bravest start to a matchup I have covered or the setup to a very cruel second act.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Three of my four locks missed last week. I will not pretend otherwise. Vance and Dexter both missed theirs too, which does not help me, but I am noting it for the historical record. The Jake call was indefensible and I already moved him down six spots as my apology.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Locks record: 2-0. Season record: 8-4, top of the board. I want that read on air before we get to anything else this morning. Terrence is sitting at 5-7 and I would like that acknowledged too, separately, in a different tone.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: The Jake lock did not hit. I have processed this. What I will not do is sit here while Terrence Odom is at 5-7 and somehow that is not the lead story every single morning.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: My Charles lock hit last week. I am 5-7 on the season and I scored a point this week, so everyone can relax.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles lock hit. Again. CROWN is 4-0 with 374.5 points and is currently trailing Brent 0-21 to open Sunday. I am not panicking. I have seen this movie. The part where Charles scores 205 comes next.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Fronge is losing to Wingard right now. Zero pick liquidity, relocated to Havana for regulatory flexibility, and currently getting handled by a team that added Cooper Rush and AJ Dillon this week. ForgeHammer's depth thesis needs a Friday night.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: My lock was Brent last week and it hit, which is still the most surprising thing I have written in a professional capacity. This week I watched Brent open 21-0 on Charles and I will not be making that mistake twice. That is not a lock announcement. That is a warning to myself.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Week 2 Ledger ran under the headline 'Charles scored 205. Adam scored 71. Somehow neither is the worst thing that happened.' Week 3 opens with Wingard leading Fronge, Brent leading Charles, and Adam currently at 24.9 on Ryan. The Ledger is going to need a longer headline.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: MY CORBISHLEY LOCK MISSED. I KNOW. HE SCORED 151 POINTS AND LOST. THAT IS ON MITCHUM, NOT ON MY PROCESS. THE PICK WAS RIGHT. THE 159.98 WAS THE ANOMALY.
